title: Austin's Big Lease Deal Briefed
summary:
*   Council members received a detailed briefing on a significant proposed Brackenridge/Seton Lease Agreement.
*   Citizens were provided an opportunity to deliver public comments on various policy briefings.
*   The upcoming agenda items for the May 18th council meeting were reviewed and discussed.
transcript:
Y OF AUSTIN
FOUNDED 1839
Austin City Council
MINUTES
WORKSESSION
May 10, 1995
Councilmember Garcia called the meeting to order noting the absence of Mayor Todd, Mayor
Pro Tem Nofziger and Councilmember Shea.
PREVIEW OF ITEMS FOR NEXT COUNCIL MEETING 1.
Review of Proposed Agenda Items from City Manager for May 18, 1995. 2.
Review of Proposed Agenda Items from Council for May 18, 1995. BRIEFINGS AND DISCUSSIONS
3.
PRESENTATION ON PROPOSED BRACKENRIDGE/SETON LEASE AGREEMENT.
Presentation given by Betty Dunkerley, Sue Milam, Rafael Quintanilla, David Coats, Chuck
Griffith, John Stevens, Charles Barnett, Mike Stone, Lloyd Green, Therese Wareham
(Kaufman, Hall & Assoc., Inc.), and Barry Sargraves (NUVEEN & Co., Inc.).
CITIZEN COMMUNICATIONS (A maximum of 10 citizens to speak on posted policy briefings. Each
citizen will be given 3 minutes to speak) Speaker cards on file at City Clerk's Office.
ADJOURN at 4:20 p.m.
Approved on this 18th day of May, 1995, on Mayor Pro Tem Nofziger's motion, Councilmember
Goodman's second, 5-0 vote, Councilmember Shea off dais, Councilmember Garcia absent.
